Frontend Playwright: 14/14 checkpoints PASS — admin@cultora.net login redirects to /admin, AdminDashboard renders admin-motor-status-widget with motor-widget-health (score '85 Excelente 85/100'), motor-widget-docs, motor-widget-rules, motor-widget-sims; motor-widget-open navigates to /admin/motor; admin-user-menu -> admin-menu-profile opens /admin/perfil; change-password-form renders with submit disabled initially, enables after filling input-current-password + input-new-password (>=8) + input-confirm-password (matching); submit shows toast 'Contraseña actualizada correctamente' and change-password-success panel appears; second submit reverts password to cultora-admin-2026 (verified via full logout + login).
critical_code_review_comments: admin_router.py — /motor/status uses `Depends(get_current_user)` + manual perm intersection instead of `Depends(_require())`. Works correctly but inconsistent with rest of the router (which uses _require + specific perms). Consider `Depends(_require())` for the 'any admin' pattern; the current perm-set check is fine but bypasses the 'status==blocked' check that _require enforces. A blocked admin whose role still grants engine.* could still call this endpoint.

admin_router.change_own_password — imports bcrypt inside the function body (`import bcrypt as _bcrypt`). Minor: prefer module-level import for consistency and to avoid per-request import cost, though Python caches it.

admin_router.change_own_password — uses `Depends(_require())` which requires admin_role. This intentionally excludes non-admin users; if the feature is later extended to public users, needs generalization. Acceptable for current spec (admin profile only).
AdminProfile.jsx — password strength meter uses only `strength >= 1` implicitly (never blocks weak passwords). Consider warning UI if strength < 2, though not a blocker.

AdminMotorStatusWidget.jsx — no retry / stale-time. If the widget errors once (e.g. brief 5xx) it stays in the error state until page refresh. Consider a manual retry button or React-Query with retry.
